answer: A second defence prices every action with work: each submission must carry a small proof-of-work stamp bound to the agent key, so a ripple of fake requests from one operator pays the compute bill again and again. The ledge checkpoint only accepts stamps solved after the epoch seed is revealed, which stops pre-computation, and a knoll of honest agents each solving once stays cheap while a farm solving a thousand times pays a thousand times. Volume becomes a linear cost instead of a free copy.
